# Claw Dash Docs

This local project documentation covers Claw Dash, a macOS dashboard for reading `.claude/` project state.

## Pages

- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Troubleshooting](TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

## Project Scope

- Poll local project folders for `.claude/` task, memory, and inbox files.
- Write a local cache for the browser dashboard and widget.
- Install LaunchAgents and an Übersicht widget for macOS use.
